newsitem.title: USA: Centocor's ReoPro seen posting strong Q4.
newsitem.headline: Centocor's ReoPro seen posting strong Q4.

text.p: Shares in Centocor Inc rose on Tuesday amid expectations that its blood-clot fighting drug will post strong sales in the fourth quarter.
Salomon Brothers analyst Meirav Chovav said she reiterated her strong buy rating on Centocor.
She said Centocor's ReoPro partner Eli Lilly and Co recently told Wall Street analysts that it expected fourth quarter ReoPro sales at $50 million "or more."
A Lilly spokesman said the company did not make public product sales forecasts.
Lilly reported worldwide ReoPro sales for the first nine months of 1996 at $98 million.
Chovav said she had a one-year price target on Centocor of $43 that she said could be conservative.
Earlier Morgan Stanley raised its price target for Centocor to $51 from $40-$45. The Morgan Stanley analyst was not immediately available for comment.
Centocor's shares were up 4-3/4 to 33-3/4 in morning trading.
